ov: الأولاد من البرازيل (الإنجليزية: The Boys from Brazil) هو فيلم إثارة تم إنتاجه في المملكة المتحدة والولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1978. الفيلم من إخراج فرانكلين شافنر من بطولة غريغوري بيك ولورنس أوليفيه وجيمس ماسون.
plotEn:
Barry Kohler, an amateur Nazi hunter, spies on a meeting of the fugitive Nazi organization Kameraden in Paraguay. Infamous Auschwitz doctor Josef Mengele is providing instructions for 94  assassinations in Western Europe and North America on particular dates over a two year span. All the targets are low-ranking  civil servants aged about sixty-five. Kohler telephones Ezra Lieberman, a well-known Nazi hunter living in Vienna, to inform him of his discovery. While still on the phone, Kohler is killed by the Kameraden.
Lieberman, himself penniless, enlists help from his sister Esther, British journalist Sidney Beynon and Jewish-American vigilante leader David Bennett. Over the next several months they investigate any sudden deaths of civil servants fitting the profile. Lieberman discovers all the dead men have sons aged 13 who look exactly alike, with pale skin, dark hair and blue eyes, all of the boys were illegally adopted and some of the adoptions were facilitated by Kameraden member Frieda Maloney. Lieberman interviews Maloney in prison and learns the boys were provided by an intermediary in Brazil. One of the adoptive fathers, American Henry Wheelock, gave her a newborn puppy in exchange for her baby.
Lieberman consults biologist Dr. Bruckner, who explains the boys' identical appearance as a result of cloning. Lieberman deduces boys are clones of Adolf Hitler, created from a single DNA sample by Mengele. Seeking to ensure their childhoods imitate that of the original Hitler
